salamanders/rules/army_rules/Special Mov:
## Shock Disembark Move
Condition:
- unit embarked within a TRANSPORT that is on the battlefield
- unit has not embarked within it this phase
Result:
- unit set up as in Set Up (core rules 03.02)
- each model set up wholly within 3" of that TRANSPORT
- afterwards: unit ineligible to declare a charge until end of turn
## Assault Disembark Move
Condition:
- unit embarked within a TRANSPORT that is on the battlefield
- unit has not embarked within it this phase
- no advance or fall-back move by that TRANSPORT this phase
Result:
- unit set up as in Set Up (core rules 03.02)
- each model set up wholly within 3" of that TRANSPORT
